basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Senior/Staff Software Engineer · Full-Stack (TypeScript) · Fintech & Data-Intensive Systems · Founder
basics.summary: Full-stack engineer with 13+ years shipping robust, tested products used by 10M+ users. I work across the stack in TypeScript and design the data models, integrations, and reliability behind data-intensive systems (Kafka, PostgreSQL, Elastic Search, ClickHouse), on a modern cloud stack (GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions). Fintech and compliance are familiar ground: I built a cross-border tax and compliance platform (SwissNRI), an explainable trading-signal system (PulseView), and financial data products at Obermatt. As a three-time founder, the impact of equity on entrepreneurship is not abstract to me, and I mentor, review, and raise engineering standards wherever I land.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Lead developer for production systems on GCP, owning architecture, data flows, and rollout.
highlights: Designed and shipped production services on GCP in TypeScript and Python, owning architecture, data flows, and rollout.
Built a knowledge-graph data layer (Neo4j) integrating 5+ systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, product usage): complex data modeling and integrations.
Instrumented every release with tracing, evals, and cost telemetry, and reported outcomes to C-level. Robust and measurable by design.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who owned architecture, data models, and delivery for products used by millions, and set the engineering standards around them.
highlights: Owned end-to-end architecture for multiple products used by 10M+ users (TypeScript, Vue, Java, Kubernetes, AWS): robust, modular, and tested by design.
Led a search platform revamp across 3 teams (indexing and ranking) over a data stack of Kafka, PostgreSQL, Elastic Search and ClickHouse: complex data transformations at scale.

Architected the Employee Referral system end to end: became the top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR), designed for a 99.99% SLA. A financial feature with reliability that customers trust.
Hired and mentored engineers, ran code reviews, and set engineering standards as deputy tech lead.

Built the cloud infrastructure and CI/CD from scratch, with reliability that enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Ledgy (founded Switzerland 2017; offices Zurich and London; NEA-led $22M Series B). Senior/Staff Software Engineer, London/Remote (hybrid 1 day/week for London or Zurich). Build elegant, scalable systems powering equity management and financial reporting for private and public companies. Collaborate with engineers (Zurich/London), PMs, and designers to build industry-leading automation. Teams: Core Equity (transaction logic, data model, core domain behaviour, accurate/scalable/compliant), Workflows & Automation (automate complex equity workflows, integrate third-party services including the trading exchange), Reporting (transform equity data into financial/operational/compliance reports across jurisdictions, large complex datasets). Good fit: 7+ years as a Software Engineer; excited about equity's impact on entrepreneurship; enjoy complex financial data transformations and compliance requirements; write clean maintainable TypeScript across backend and frontend; excited to work with React, Node.js, and MongoDB; thrive in collaborative environments and pair programming; take pride in robust, tested solutions for critical business operations. Tech stack: TypeScript; Frontend React, Tailwind CSS, tRPC; Backend tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB; Infrastructure GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions. Interview: CV review, intro, 75-min live coding on an equity domain problem, 60-min system design, culture interview with a founder.
_jobApplication.notes: Positioned as a full-stack product engineer: 13+ years, TypeScript across the stack, data-intensive systems at scale (Kafka/PostgreSQL/Elastic/ClickHouse), infra that matches the JD (GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions), engineering standards + mentoring + code review, and fintech/compliance domain (SwissNRI, PulseView, Obermatt, Opt Alpha) plus founder empathy for equity/entrepreneurship. Beekeeper moved to the top as the strongest full-stack/data/scale role. Honest gaps NOT fabricated: primary frontend framework is Vue, not React (transferable, TypeScript is shared); backend depth is Java/Python rather than Node.js/tRPC; MongoDB is via certification (MongoDB for Java Developers) rather than heavy production use; no cap-table/equity-specific domain experience (broader fintech + compliance instead).
